caption: Creating a tracking number: area code 212 (New York) gave No numbers available, and the step shows no price for a number.
With area code 415 CallRail generated a local California number at once, again with no price or card request. The number itself is hidden.
Routing is where we stopped. Activate tracking number stays grey until you enter a forwarding number, and call recording is ticked by default.
Right after sign up the account was held for review because of unusual activity, so we could not see the dashboard or reports.

The public pricing page, billed yearly: Lead Tracking $50, Lead Tracking Complete $95, Lead Conversion $150 and Lead Conversion Complete $195 a month, each plus usage. Packages start with 5 numbers and 250 minutes.
